name: Alaska
source: Alaska levies no personal income tax: the individual net income tax was repealed by chapter 2, SSSLA 1980 (https://www.akleg.gov/pdf/11/Bills/Final/CH%202%20SSSLA%201980.pdf, read in a search extract on 2026-10-22; the PDF refused the fetch); second sources: MOAA state report card (https://www.moaa.org/content/state-report-card/alaska/) and Tax Foundation, State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/state-income-tax-rates-2026/)

state_base.note: Alaska has no state income tax.

estate_inheritance.check_at: Alaska Statutes 43.31 (estate tax tied to the federal state death tax credit)
estate_inheritance.note: Alaska levies no estate tax and no inheritance tax: its estate tax was tied to the federal state death tax credit, which ended in 2005 (state-costs.csv columns estate_tax and inheritance_tax; Tax Foundation and Kiplinger state death-tax lists).

social_security.note: Alaska has no personal income tax, so Social Security benefits are not taxed. Confirmed primary on https://www.akleg.gov/pdf/11/Bills/Final/CH%202%20SSSLA%201980.pdf (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: Alaska city and county tax codes (no local income tax is authorised)
local_income_tax.note: Alaska counties and cities levy no income tax (state-costs.csv local_income_tax 'none'; no agency page read).

sales_tax.check_at: Alaska revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: assumed equal to the combined rate. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: partly); research note: No state sales tax; some boroughs/cities tax food and some exempt it. clothing_taxable is false (research: no; No state tax; some localities tax clothing). Some towns tax groceries and others do not; the estimate uses the general average local rate, so it overstates. Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.source: 0.94% on owner-occupied housing value, Tax Foundation Alaska page (https://taxfoundation.org/location/alaska/, validation run 3, 2026-10-22)
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Set by hand from a secondary source in validation run 3, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Research note: auto_full_usd unconfirmed (Insurify excludes AK). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.check_at: https://dmv.alaska.gov (fee chart) and the Municipality of Anchorage motor vehicle registration tax
car_taxes.source: Alaska DMV 2024 fee chart (100 per two years) and Anchorage ordinance AO 2010-81 (registration tax 150 in year one falling to 70 from year eight, per two years)
car_taxes.note: Alaska: state registration of 100 per two years (50 a year) plus a borough or municipal motor vehicle registration tax where levied (Anchorage about 70 to 150 per two years); about 90 a year in a city. Typical car, averaged over about ten years of ownership; registration and vehicle taxes only (no title, plate or inspection fees). Set by hand after the import: rerunning importStateCosts.py resets it to 0. Accepted: low impact (triage 2026-10-23): Search extract of AO2011-030 matches the 150->70 age schedule.

fuel.check_at: Alaska motor fuel tax page and EIA gasoline prices (https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/)
fuel.source: Excise: USGasGauge/EIA (https://usgasgauge.com/gas-tax) and Kiplinger 2026 for some states, memory for the rest; price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel; average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Alaska insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Research note: MA not sold in AK per source. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
